description: Discover tracks by filter: label ID, artist ID, genre name or genre ID (from list_genres), or release year. At least one filter is required. Needs a paid SonoVault tier; free-tier keys get a 403.

genre.description: Exact genre name (mutually exclusive with genre_id)

genre_id.description: Canonical genre ID (mutually exclusive with genre)

randomize.description: Sample randomly instead of newest first
